_comment: Curated definition of the metro / monorail lines. Stations and track geometry come from data/metro/osm (OpenStreetMap, see scripts/fetch_metro_osm.py); everything else (service hours, headways, journey times) comes from the sources named per line. Metro lines publish first/last trains and headways, not a timetable, so scripts/metro.py generates a synthetic one from them. 'active': false keeps a line out of the routing data (see status).

lines.name: Metro Line 1 (Blue)
sources: mumbaimetroroute.com /timetable: first 05:30, last 23:25 (Versova) / 23:50 (Ghatkopar); peak 08:00-11:00 and 17:00-21:00 every 3-4 min, other weekday hours 5-7 min
Wikipedia 'Blue Line (Mumbai Metro)': 21 min Versova-Ghatkopar (the site's own 40-45 min is not used)

lines.name: Metro Line 2A (Yellow)
sources: mumbaimetroroute.com /metro-lines/line-2a: 17 stations, peak 5-7 min, off-peak 10-12 min; station names (Kandarpada = OSM 'Rushi Sankul')
40 min end to end (news); peak windows assumed 07:30-11:00 and 17:00-21:00

lines.name: Metro Lines 7 + 9 (Red)
sources: mmmocl.co.in/train-time-table (official, 2026-10-03): Gundavali-Kashigaon first 06:00 / last 23:00, Kashigaon-Gundavali first 05:50 / last 22:30. Line 7 and Line 9 phase 1 run as one integrated service

mumbaimetroroute.com /metro-lines/line-7 and line-9: Line 7 peak 7-8 min, off-peak 10-12 min; Line 9 peak 6 min, off-peak 8-10 min (Line 7's values are used for the joined line); 'Poisar' = OSM 'Mahindra & Mahindra'
35 min for Line 7's 16.5 km (news) = 28.3 km/h, applied to the whole line

lines.name: Metro Line 3 (Aqua)
sources: MMRCL timetable as reported (freepressjournal, wionews): first 05:55 both ends, last departure 22:30; Mon-Sat peak (08:00-10:00, 17:00-21:00) 3.5 min, off-peak 8 min
54 min end to end (freepressjournal). Sunday (8 min all day) is not modelled

mumbaimetroroute.com /metro-lines/line-3: 27 stations, interchanges with Marol Naka (Line 1) and Santacruz, Dadar, Mahalaxmi, Mumbai Central, Grant Road, CSMT, Churchgate. Its frequency figures conflict (3-4 min on the overview, 7-8 min on the line page), so the operator's 3.5 / 8 min is kept

lines.name: Metro Line 2B (Yellow, phase 1)
sources: mumbaimetroroute.com /metro-lines/line-2b: 5 stations Diamond Garden, Shivaji Chowk, BSNL Metro, Mankhurd, Mandale; 9-10 min; interchange with the Harbour line at Mankhurd. Chembur station (first OSM stop) is not open, so it is skipped
journey time estimated at 28 km/h, the speed of Lines 2A/7

inactive.name: Mumbai Monorail
inactive.status: Service suspended since 2025-09-20 for new rolling stock and CBTC signalling; trial runs ongoing, restart announced repeatedly but not confirmed as of 2026-10-03 (freepressjournal 2026-08-15, Wikipedia). Add it as an 'active' line with the 17 stations Chembur ... Sant Gadge Maharaj Chowk (Jacob Circle), 15 min headway, 06:00-22:07, once passenger service resumes.
inactive.line_4: Metro Line 4 / 4A (Wadala-Kasarvadavali) has no passenger service yet; partial Gaimukh-Cadbury Junction opening is targeted for November 2026.

inactive.name: Navi Mumbai Metro Line 1 (CBD Belapur - Pendhar)
inactive.status: Switched off on 2026-10-03: not listed on mumbaimetroroute.com, and its service is unconfirmed. Wikipedia and news sites say it opened 2023-11-17 (11 stations, 06:00-22:00, every 10-15 min). Data is ready: data/metro/osm/NM1.json; to enable, move this entry back to 'lines' with parts [{osm: NM1}], agency CIDCO, avg_speed_kmh 32, directions CBD Belapur / Pendhar 06:00-21:45, headway 15 min (10 in the peaks).
